description: Opt-out dengan panduan untuk FastPeopleSearch. Seseorang mengikuti langkah-langkah pada daftar periksa; OpenOptOut menyediakan alamat email sekali pakai dan mengeklik tautan konfirmasi.
instructions: Search fastpeoplesearch.com for {full_name}. If you're listed, open fastpeoplesearch.com/optout and follow the steps to remove your record; you may need to solve a CAPTCHA. If it asks for an email address, use {contact_email}, so OpenOptOut can click any confirmation link for you. Kemudian tekan "Saya sudah melakukan ini".
